rows.name: tip-seam-under-pointer
rows.expected: a typed 3 by 4 table selected (four rows, so the right edge "+" sits on row seam 2); the "+" hovered and clicked: a column is added and the seam that lands under the resting pointer draws no plate; the pointer moves 12 px along the seam and its plate draws
rows.observed: plate on the "+" "Add a column A column at the right edge, as wide as the last one. The table grows by it."; columns 3 -> 4; under the resting pointer after the click: handle.fx-table.row.1; plate after the click none; after a 12 px move along the seam "Column seam 3 Drag to resize the column. The next column takes the difference. Left and Right step 1 px, Shift 10 px."; 04-after-61-edge-plus-moved-2x.png

rows.name: seam-tooltip-words
rows.expected: the table selected; the first row seam hovered: its plate reads the row sentence with no semicolon
rows.observed: handle.fx-table.row.1: plate "Row seam 2 Drag to resize the row. The rows below move and the table grows. Up and Down step 1 px, Shift 10 px."; semicolon false

rows.name: check-slides-sentences
rows.expected: a picture and an empty 3 by 3 table on a blank slide; Tools > Check slides: no finding carries a semicolon, a parenthesis or SPEC
rows.observed: 4 findings: "A picture without a dark twin keeps a 1 px frame so it reads as a plate on the dark ground.Fix" | "The table has 9 empty cells. Type into them or remove the rows." | "In native mode an image exports as a 2x raster." | "This slide is arranged by hand. Apply layout re-flows it."; with a semicolon 0; plain true

rows.name: tip-hover-and-tab
rows.expected: the pointer moves onto Undo: its plate draws after the delay; Escape, then Tab from the sheet until a chrome control has the focus: its plate draws at once
